key_impacts: Over 13 lakh people were evacuated in Odisha and Andhra Pradesh.
21 deaths occurred due to the cyclone.
Subsequent flooding caused 23 additional deaths in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh.
18 districts in Odisha and 3 districts in Andhra Pradesh were affected by the cyclone.
Significant flooding occurred in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh.
missing_information: Exact dates for the subsequent flooding are not specified.
Specific names of the affected districts are not provided.
Detailed damage/loss figures beyond evacuations and fatalities are not given.
